components.purpose: Section heading — provides the 'Why teams choose us' heading and a short subheading, placed above the feature cards (this Header model, id 25, has Heading, Subheading, and Description fields; note there's also a model named 'Header' at id 15 that is the site's global header with Logo/Navigation — not this one).

Feature cards — the existing grid of feature items below the new heading; its own built-in Heading/Subheading fields can be left blank since the Header component above already supplies the section title.
